title: Microsoft multi-year multibillion investment in OpenAI
detail: Microsoft extends partnership with a reported ~$10B investment, implying roughly a $29B valuation.

title: ChatGPT Plus launched at $20/month
detail: Paid subscription tier for ChatGPT with priority access and faster response times.

title: Google invests about $300M in Anthropic
detail: Google took a stake in Anthropic in early 2023, reported as about $300M for roughly 10%. Not verified in this session.

title: Google announces Bard (soft launch to trusted testers)
detail: Sundar Pichai announced Bard, a LaMDA-based chatbot, for trusted testers, with a broader public rollout to follow. Bard was later opened publicly in the US and UK around 2023-03-21.

title: Reid Hoffman leaves OpenAI board
detail: Reported departure of Reid Hoffman from the board.

title: GPT-4 announced
detail: Multimodal model accepting image and text input, released to ChatGPT Plus and via API waitlist.

title: ChatGPT plugins beta
detail: Third-party plugin ecosystem launched for ChatGPT in beta.

title: Google Brain and DeepMind merge into Google DeepMind
detail: Google combined Google Brain and DeepMind into one unit under Demis Hassabis. Not verified in this session.

title: Google I/O 2023: PaLM 2 and Bard expansion
detail: Google I/O 2023 announced PaLM 2 and expanded Bard. Not verified in this session.

title: Governance of superintelligence post
detail: Altman, Brockman and Sutskever propose an IAEA-style international oversight body for superintelligence.

title: Class action over alleged scraping of training data filed in San Francisco
detail: Sixteen anonymous plaintiffs sue over alleged use of about 300 billion words of internet data.

title: Superalignment initiative announced
detail: Dedicated team to solve alignment of superintelligent systems, with 20 percent of compute pledged.

title: Authors Silverman, Tremblay and others sue OpenAI for copyright infringement
detail: Copyright suit over use of books in training data.

title: Claude 2 released (public beta, US and UK first)
detail: Claude 2 launched with a 100K-token context window; API access for businesses and claude.ai for US/UK users.

title: FTC civil investigative demand reported
detail: FTC probe into data security and privacy practices, reported in July 2023.

title: Llama 2 released with Microsoft Azure and Windows support
detail: Open-weight Llama 2 for research and commercial use, announced jointly with Microsoft at Microsoft Inspire and added to the Azure AI catalog.

title: Acquires Global Illumination
detail: Small product and infrastructure team acquisition to support ChatGPT work.

title: ChatGPT Enterprise launched
detail: Business tier with admin controls, no training on customer data by default, and longer context.

title: Authors Guild class action filed (17 authors incl. George R. R. Martin)
detail: Copyright class action over training on author works.

title: DALL-E 3 announced
detail: Text-to-image model integrated with ChatGPT; rolled out to ChatGPT Plus and Enterprise in October 2023.

title: ChatGPT voice and image input rolled out
detail: Voice conversations and image understanding (GPT-4V) added to ChatGPT for paid users.

title: Amazon agrees to invest up to $4B in Anthropic
detail: Initial $1.25B in cash; Amazon chose AWS as primary cloud. Later tranches followed in 2024.

title: Music publishers (Concord, UMG, ABKCO) sue Anthropic over lyrics (Concord I)
detail: Lawsuit filed in N.D. Cal. over 499 works. Filing month is confirmed by sources; exact day is from memory.

title: DALL-E 3 rolled out in ChatGPT Plus
detail: Image generation available to paying ChatGPT subscribers.

title: Google commits up to $2B to Anthropic
detail: Additional Google investment in Anthropic, reported Oct 2023. Not verified in this session.

title: GPT-4 Turbo preview announced at DevDay 2023
detail: 128k context window, cheaper API pricing, knowledge cutoff April 2023; gpt-4-1106-preview.

title: DevDay 2023: GPTs, GPT Store preview, Assistants API
detail: Custom GPTs announced; Assistants API and multimodal API features launched.

title: Board fires Sam Altman as CEO; Mira Murati named interim CEO
detail: Board statement cites lack of consistent candor. Greg Brockman also removed from board.

title: Greg Brockman resigns
detail: Brockman quits after Altman's removal; several senior researchers also leave.

title: Emmett Shear named interim CEO after Altman return talks fail
detail: Murati replaced as interim CEO after the board's talks with Altman collapse.

title: Altman reinstated as CEO; new board with Bret Taylor as chair
detail: Agreement in principle restores Altman and Brockman; Larry Summers joins the board; Helen Toner, Tasha McCauley and Ilya Sutskever leave the board.

title: Claude 2.1 released (200K context, tool use beta)
detail: 200K context window (Pro users); claimed 2x reduction in hallucination rate; system prompts and tool use (beta).

title: Microsoft gets non-voting board observer seat
detail: Microsoft representative joins the board as a non-voting observer.

title: Gemini 1.0 announced (Ultra, Pro, Nano)
detail: Gemini 1.0 launched in Ultra, Pro and Nano sizes. Pro powered Bard; Nano shipped on Pixel 8 Pro. Ultra was limited to early testers at launch.

title: New York Times sues OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement
detail: Filed in the Southern District of New York over use of Times articles for training.

title: GPT Store launched; ChatGPT Team plan introduced
detail: Marketplace for custom GPTs opens; Team plan offers shared workspace for small businesses.

title: Bard renamed Gemini; Gemini Advanced (Ultra 1.0) and Android app launched
detail: Bard became Gemini, with a paid Gemini Advanced tier running Ultra 1.0 and a new Gemini Android app.

title: ChatGPT memory test begins
detail: ChatGPT can remember user details across conversations, first tested with a subset of users.

title: Sora text-to-video model announced (not publicly released)
detail: Video generation model shown to select red-teamers and creatives.

title: Gemini 1.5 Pro announced (limited preview, 1M context)
detail: Gemini 1.5 Pro previewed to developers and enterprises via AI Studio and Vertex AI with a 1M-token context window. Some sources say Feb 16.

title: Gemma 2B and 7B released (open-weights family)
detail: First Gemma release, built from Gemini research. Initially under Google's own terms, not a standard open-source license.

title: SEC reportedly investigating whether investors were misled about Altman
detail: WSJ-reported SEC inquiry into Altman's candor with investors.

title: Elon Musk sues OpenAI and Sam Altman
detail: Suit alleges OpenAI shifted from nonprofit public-benefit mission toward profit.

title: Claude 3 family (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) announced
detail: Opus and Sonnet available at launch; Haiku promised 'soon'.

title: Claude 3 Haiku becomes available
detail: Haiku became generally available after the 2024-03-04 launch. Date from memory.

title: Nvidia unveils Blackwell B200 and GB200 at GTC 2024
detail: B200 GPU and GB200 platform (Grace CPU plus B200 GPUs; GB200 NVL72 rack). Nvidia claimed about 5x inference performance over H100 (vendor claim).

title: OpenAI countersues Musk
detail: Counterclaim alleges bad-faith litigation tactics.

title: Llama 3 released (8B and 70B)
detail: Open-weight Llama 3 in 8B and 70B sizes, pre-trained on about 15T tokens; Meta AI assistant launched alongside.

title: Eight newspapers sue OpenAI and Microsoft
detail: Copyright suit in SDNY over alleged harvesting of news articles.

title: GPT-4o announced (omni model, free tier access)
detail: Native audio, vision and text model; faster and cheaper than GPT-4 Turbo; made available to free users.

title: Ilya Sutskever resigns; Jakub Pachocki named chief scientist
detail: Co-lead of superalignment departs.

title: Google I/O 2024: Gemini 1.5 Flash, Project Astra, Imagen 3, Veo, Trillium TPU
detail: Keynote launched Gemini 1.5 Flash (1M context), previewed Project Astra, Imagen 3, Veo, Gemini Live, and the Trillium TPU.

title: Gemini 1.5 Flash announced
detail: Lighter, faster Gemini 1.5 model for high-volume tasks; fastest Gemini in the API at launch.

title: Project Astra previewed
detail: Real-time multimodal assistant prototype shown at I/O 2024.

title: Reddit content partnership announced
detail: Licensing deal giving OpenAI access to Reddit data for ChatGPT.

title: Jan Leike departs; superalignment team dissolved
detail: Leike cites safety culture concerns; team folded into other research.

title: News Corp content agreement
detail: Licensing deal covering WSJ, New York Post, The Times and The Sunday Times.

title: Former employees released from non-disparagement agreements
detail: OpenAI memo ends the lifelong non-disparagement clause for departing staff.

title: Sarah Friar hired as first CFO
detail: Former Nextdoor CEO joins as chief financial officer.

title: Apple Intelligence announced at WWDC 2024, with ChatGPT integration
detail: Apple Intelligence announced for iOS 18, iPadOS 18 and macOS Sequoia. ChatGPT integration into Siri and Writing Tools is opt-in, rolling out later in 2024.

title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet released
detail: Outperformed Claude 3 Opus at half the price. Some sources say June 21.

title: Claude Artifacts launched with Claude 3.5 Sonnet
detail: Artifacts shipped alongside Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Date from memory.

title: Gemma 2 (9B, 27B) released
detail: Second Gemma generation, 9B and 27B sizes.

title: GPT-4o mini released
detail: Small, low-cost model replacing GPT-3.5 Turbo as the default cheap API model.

title: Llama 3.1 released, including 405B
detail: Llama 3.1 collection of 8B, 70B and 405B models with 128K context. The 405B model was the first Llama model at that size.

title: Mistral Large 2 (123B) released
detail: 123B-parameter flagship with 128K context. Weights under the Mistral Research License; commercial use via the paid API or a commercial license. Benchmarks are vendor-reported.

title: Advanced Voice Mode alpha to ChatGPT Plus
detail: Limited alpha of real-time voice conversation with GPT-4o for paid users.

title: John Schulman leaves for Anthropic; Greg Brockman takes extended leave
detail: Schulman, a co-founder, departs; Brockman steps back until November.

title: gpt-4o-2024-08-06 with Structured Outputs
detail: Updated GPT-4o snapshot with JSON schema-constrained outputs in the API.

title: o1-preview and o1-mini released
detail: First o-series reasoning models in ChatGPT and API.

title: Advanced Voice Mode rolled out to all Plus users
detail: Broader release of real-time voice in ChatGPT.

title: Mira Murati, Bob McGrew and Barret Zoph depart
detail: CTO Murati and research leaders leave the company the same day.

title: DevDay 2024: Realtime API, prompt caching, vision fine-tuning
detail: Realtime API for speech-to-speech in beta; prompt caching for lower API cost.

title: $6.6B raise at $157B post-money valuation
detail: Led by Thrive Capital with Microsoft and Nvidia participating; revolving credit facility added.

title: Canvas launched in ChatGPT
detail: Side-by-side editor for writing and code.

title: Upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet, new Claude 3.5 Haiku, and computer use (public beta)
detail: Computer use launched with the upgraded Sonnet, not Haiku. Haiku was announced for later that month.

title: ChatGPT search launched
detail: Web search with citations integrated into ChatGPT for all users.

title: Claude 3.5 Haiku generally available
detail: Haiku became available after the 2024-10-22 announcement; date is from LongTermWiki and may be off by days.

title: Amazon commits another $4B to Anthropic; AWS named primary training partner
detail: Second $4B Amazon commitment. Date from memory.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) introduced as open standard
detail: Open protocol with Python and TypeScript SDKs and reference servers (Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Git, Postgres, Puppeteer).

title: Genie 2 world model announced
detail: DeepMind's second-generation generative world model. Date from memory.

title: o1 full release in ChatGPT and API
detail: Full o1 model replaces o1-preview; part of the 12 Days of OpenAI event.

title: ChatGPT Pro launched at $200/month
detail: Higher-limit tier with unlimited o1 and advanced voice access.

title: Sora released publicly to ChatGPT Plus and Pro
detail: Text-to-video generation available at sora.com.

title: Gemini 2.0 Flash (experimental) announced
detail: Google's 'agentic era' model, outperforming 1.5 Pro at twice the speed. Google's blog is dated Dec 12; the social announcement is Dec 11.

title: Project Mariner (browser agent) and Jules (code agent) announced
detail: Project Mariner is an early Chrome-extension research prototype. Jules is a coding agent. Both were announced with Gemini 2.0.

title: Advanced Voice with video and screen sharing
detail: Adds camera and screen sharing to real-time voice in ChatGPT.

title: Veo 2 announced
detail: Google's video generation model. Date from memory.

title: o3 and o3-mini announced (not released)
detail: Shown on final day of 12 Days; o3-mini released later in January 2025.

title: DeepSeek-V3 released (671B MoE, 37B active)
detail: Open-weight MoE model, 671B total and 37B active parameters, about 14.8T training tokens per the tech report. Weights appeared on Hugging Face around Dec 25; most sources date the announcement Dec 26, while some say Dec 24.

title: Reports of plan to convert for-profit arm to public benefit corporation
detail: Reported plan to restructure the capped-profit arm; later executed as the 2025 recapitalization.

title: DeepSeek-R1 released as open source under MIT license
detail: Reasoning model that DeepSeek said matches OpenAI-o1 on benchmarks. Six distilled models (including 32B and 70B) were also open-sourced.

title: Stargate Project announced (Oracle, SoftBank, MGX)
detail: Joint venture for up to $500B of US AI infrastructure over four years.

title: Google reportedly invests about $1B more in Anthropic
detail: Additional Google investment reported Jan 2025. Not verified in this session.

title: Operator computer-using agent unveiled
detail: Research preview for Pro users that uses its own browser to complete tasks.

title: Qwen2.5-Max released (closed MoE flagship)
detail: Alibaba Cloud flagship positioned against GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3 and Llama-3.1-405B on selected benchmarks (vendor claims). Not an open-weight release. Reports say Jan 28 or 29.

title: o3-mini released
detail: Cost-efficient reasoning model available free in ChatGPT with reasoning effort controls.

title: Deep research launched
detail: Agent that browses the web and writes multi-page research reports; Pro tier first.

title: Gemini 2.0 Flash GA; Gemini 2.0 Pro (experimental) and 2.0 Flash-Lite (preview) released
detail: Developer-facing expansion of the Gemini 2.0 family. Date from memory.

title: Musk-led group makes $97.4B unsolicited bid for nonprofit
detail: Bid rejected by OpenAI on 2025-02-14.

title: Grok 3 unveiled (Reasoning and mini Reasoning)
detail: Livestream on Feb 17 US time (Feb 18 elsewhere). Musk said trained on Colossus, which xAI described as over 100,000 Nvidia Hopper GPUs. Premium-only at launch, free by Feb 20. Benchmarks are company claims.

title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet (hybrid reasoning) and Claude Code research preview
detail: First hybrid reasoning model; Claude Code launched as a limited research preview in the terminal.

title: GPT-4.5 research preview released
detail: Large, non-reasoning model with improved writing and world knowledge; Pro tier first.

title: Series E: $3.5B at $61.5B post-money (Lightspeed lead)
detail: Round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Other investors included Fidelity, Menlo, Salesforce Ventures and General Catalyst.

title: Apple confirms personalized Siri features are delayed
detail: Apple said onscreen awareness, personal context and App Intents features would take longer than expected; they had been promised for iOS 18.4 (April 2025). No new feature launched that day.

title: CoreWeave $11.9B contract with OpenAI
detail: Five-year compute capacity agreement reported by Reuters.

title: Responses API and Agents SDK launched
detail: Developer primitives for building agents, including built-in web search and file search tools.

title: Gemma 3 released (1B, 4B, 12B, 27B)
detail: Gemma 3 open-weights family. Sources give March 10 or March 12.

title: Image generation in GPT-4o launched
detail: Native image generation in ChatGPT, rolled out to all users in the following weeks.

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental released
detail: First Gemini 2.5 model, a thinking model with a 1M-token context window, topping LMArena at launch. Some sources say March 26.

title: xAI acquires X in all-stock deal
detail: Musk announced X folded into xAI via share swap. xAI valued at $80B and X at $33B net of $12B debt ($45B gross). Both sides exchanged for shares of a new xAI Holdings Corp.

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental opened to all free Gemini users
detail: Free access with reduced context and speed, about four days after the 2.5 Pro launch. Sources give March 29 or 30.

title: $40B round at $300B post-money valuation
detail: Led by SoftBank; largest private tech financing at the time.

title: Llama 4 Scout and Maverick released (Behemoth not released)
detail: First MoE Llama models. Scout is 109B total / 17B active with 10M context; Maverick is 400B total / 17B active. Behemoth (about 2T) served as teacher and was not released. Llama 4 Community License.

title: Safe Superintelligence raises $2B at $32B valuation
detail: Greenoaks led (about $500M reported), with Lightspeed and Andreessen Horowitz also investing. Google Cloud became primary compute provider (TPUs). SSI has no product.

title: GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini and nano released (API only)
detail: Coding and long-context (1M tokens) improvements; available only through the API.

title: o3 and o4-mini released
detail: o3 is the flagship reasoning model with tool use; o4-mini is the cost-efficient reasoning model.

title: Gemini 2.5 Flash preview released
detail: Flash variant of Gemini 2.5, with the 04-17 version later cited as the basis for GA. Date from memory plus one source.

title: Ziff Davis sues OpenAI
detail: Copyright suit filed in Delaware federal court.

title: GPT-4o sycophancy update rolled back
detail: OpenAI reverts an update that made ChatGPT overly flattering.

title: Nonprofit to keep control; for-profit to become a public benefit corporation
detail: OpenAI announces the nonprofit will retain control of the for-profit arm, replacing the planned full conversion.

title: Mistral Medium 3 released (proprietary multimodal)
detail: Closed-weight multimodal model with 128K context. Mistral has since deprecated this version.

title: Fidji Simo named CEO of Applications
detail: Former Instacart CEO to lead ChatGPT and product applications.

title: WSJ reports Meta delays Llama 4 Behemoth
detail: Report says Meta pulled back on a public Behemoth release over concern it was not enough of an advance. Behemoth was never publicly released. Reported, not an official Meta announcement.

title: Codex cloud coding agent launched (research preview)
detail: Agent that runs software tasks in a sandbox, available to ChatGPT Pro, Plus and Team users.

title: Google I/O 2025: Veo 3, Gemini 2.5 updates, Google AI Ultra, AI Mode
detail: I/O 2025 ran May 20-21. Announced Veo 3 with native audio, Gemini 2.5 updates, the Google AI Ultra subscription, and AI Mode in Search.

title: Veo 3 announced (native audio, 4K)
detail: Google's video model with native audio, shown at I/O 2025. Exact day from memory.

title: Gemma 3n preview released
detail: Mobile-first Gemma variant previewed at I/O 2025. Date from memory.

title: Imagen 4 announced
detail: Google's image generation model, shown around I/O 2025. Date from memory.

title: OpenAI acquires io (Jony Ive hardware startup) in ~$6.5B all-stock deal
detail: Ive and his design team join OpenAI to build consumer AI devices; hardware not yet released.

title: Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 released; extended thinking with tool use (beta)
detail: Opus 4 positioned as the strongest coding model (72.5% SWE-bench). Sonnet 4 was offered to free users. API $15/$75 for Opus 4 and $3/$15 for Sonnet 4.

title: Claude Code generally available (terminal, IDE, SDK)
detail: Claude Code moved to GA with the Claude 4 launch, with VS Code and JetBrains integrations in beta.

title: Claude Opus 4 released under ASL-3 safeguards
detail: Anthropic activated AI Safety Level 3 protections alongside the Opus 4 release. Date from memory.

title: DeepSeek-R1-0528 quietly released on Hugging Face
detail: Undocumented first revision of R1 with no official announcement. Benchmark gains (for example AIME 2025) come from third-party aggregators.

title: o3-pro released; o3 API price cut about 80%
detail: o3-pro for Pro users and API; o3 pricing reduced sharply.

title: Magistral Medium and Magistral Small (reasoning) released
detail: Mistral's first dedicated reasoning models. Magistral Medium built on the Medium 3 base. Later versions 1.1 (Jul 24) and 1.2 (Sep 18).

title: Koray Kavukcuoglu named Google chief AI architect
detail: Kavukcuoglu, previously DeepMind CTO, took a cross-Google chief AI architect role. Exact day from memory.

title: Meta takes 49% non-voting stake in Scale AI for $14.3B; Alexandr Wang joins Meta
detail: Values Scale at about $29B. Wang moved to Meta to lead superintelligence work; Scale stays independent under interim CEO Jason Droege. Reported June 10-13, 2025; exact official date unconfirmed.

title: Pentagon CDAO prototype contract reported (up to $200M)
detail: Reported defense prototype contract for frontier AI.

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash generally available; 2.5 Flash-Lite preview
detail: Stable releases for production use. Flash-Lite launched as a preview. Sources disagree on which underlying version reached GA.

title: Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL) formed under Alexandr Wang
detail: Zuckerberg memo: MSL covers Meta's AI models, products and FAIR. Wang named Chief AI Officer; Nat Friedman to partner on leading MSL; 11 hires announced. Llama 4 reception cited as a driver.

title: Daniel Gross leaves SSI; Ilya Sutskever becomes CEO
detail: Gross departed as of June 29, 2025 and joined Meta. Sutskever announced the change on X; Daniel Levy named president.

title: Grok 4 and Grok 4 Heavy launched
detail: Livestream July 9, 2025 at 8pm PT (July 10 in some outlets). Company-reported benchmarks. A coding variant (grok-4-code-0629) was spotted in API listings.

title: Windsurf acquisition (~$3B) collapses
detail: Deal lapses; Windsurf leadership moves to Google.

title: Kimi K2 open-weight release (about 1T MoE, 32B active)
detail: Base and Instruct variants under a modified MIT license (credit required above 100M MAU or $20M monthly revenue). Reports date the release July 11 or 12.

title: US Department of Defense contract with Anthropic (classified networks)
detail: Claude became the first frontier model approved for classified government networks under a July 2025 DoD contract. Exact day from memory.

title: Thinking Machines Lab closes $2B seed at $12B valuation
detail: Led by Andreessen Horowitz per company spokesperson. Pre-money figures vary across reports (some say $10B).

title: ChatGPT agent launched
detail: Merges Operator and deep research into a single agent with its own virtual computer.

title: Experimental model reaches gold-level IMO performance
detail: OpenAI reports gold-medal-level score on the International Mathematical Olympiad with a general-purpose reasoning model.

title: Gemini Deep Think achieves IMO gold-medal standard
detail: Advanced Gemini Deep Think solved 5 of 6 IMO 2025 problems (35 points), officially graded by IMO coordinators.

title: Stargate expansion with Oracle to 4.5 GW reported
detail: Oracle and OpenAI plan about 4.5 GW of Stargate capacity; first site in Abilene, Texas.

title: Qwen3-Coder released (480B-A35B MoE) with Qwen Code CLI
detail: Open-weight coding flagship with 256K native context, extendable to 1M. Reports differ on July 22 vs July 23.

title: GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air open-sourced
detail: GLM-4.5 is 355B total / 32B active MoE; Air is 106B. Hybrid thinking and non-thinking modes. MIT-style license. Released after WAIC.

title: Gemini 2.5 Deep Think rolled out to Gemini app Ultra subscribers
detail: Faster daily-use variant of the IMO gold model for Google AI Ultra subscribers, announced by Logan Kilpatrick.

title: gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b open-weight models released
detail: First open-weight models from OpenAI since GPT-2; Apache 2.0 license.

title: Claude Opus 4.1 released
detail: Incremental Opus upgrade. API pricing $15 input.

title: Genie 3 world model unveiled
detail: Generates real-time explorable 3D worlds at 720p and 24 fps; not publicly released at launch. Sources give Aug 5 or 6.

title: GPT-5 launched (gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano)
detail: Unified model with real-time routing between fast and reasoning modes; free users get access. Livestreamed.

title: ChatGPT Go launched in India
detail: Lower-priced subscription tier, later expanded to more countries.

title: DeepSeek-V3.1 released with hybrid thinking and non-thinking modes
detail: 671B total / 37B active, 128K context. DeepSeek said V3.1-Think matches R1-0528 quality with faster responses and framed it as a step toward the agent era.

title: Raine v. OpenAI wrongful-death lawsuit filed
detail: Parents of a 16-year-old allege ChatGPT contributed to his death.

title: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana) launched
detail: Image generation and editing model that went viral as Nano Banana after anonymous LMArena testing. Some sources give Aug 27.

title: Anthropic reaches $1.5B settlement with authors (Bartz v. Anthropic)
detail: Settlement over pirated books used in training, about $3,100 per work for roughly 480,000 works. Settlement reported Aug 2025; exact day from memory.

title: gpt-realtime and Realtime API general availability
detail: Production speech-to-speech model in the API with new voices.

title: Microsoft unveils first in-house models: MAI-Voice-1 and MAI-1-preview
detail: MAI-Voice-1 speech model already powers Copilot Daily. MAI-1-preview is a MoE text model pre-trained on about 15,000 H100s and tested on LMArena. Parameter count undisclosed.

title: Agrees to acquire Statsig for ~$1.1B
detail: Experimentation platform acquisition; Statsig CEO becomes CTO of Applications.

title: Series F: $13B at $183B post-money (ICONIQ lead)
detail: Co-led by Fidelity and Lightspeed; Anthropic cited enterprise demand and safety research. Some outlets date coverage Sep 4.

title: Mistral raises EUR 1.7B Series C at EUR 11.7B post-money, led by ASML
detail: ASML took about 11% (about EUR 1.3B) and signed a joint research partnership; an ASML CFO joined Mistral's strategic committee. Existing investors include Nvidia, a16z, DST, General Catalyst and Bpifrance.

title: Oracle ~$300B five-year compute contract reported
detail: Reported contract for about 4.5 GW of compute starting around 2027.

title: GPT-5-Codex released
detail: GPT-5 variant optimized for agentic coding in Codex.

title: Nvidia invests $5B in Intel; joint x86 and RTX products announced
detail: Nvidia bought $5B of Intel stock at $23.28/share. Partnership covers x86 CPU plus RTX GPU chiplet SoCs for PCs and custom x86 CPUs for Nvidia data center platforms.

title: Nvidia letter of intent for up to $100B investment and 10 GW
detail: Nvidia to invest progressively as each gigawatt is deployed; first gigawatt planned for 2026.

title: Nvidia and OpenAI sign letter of intent for 10 GW of Nvidia systems; Nvidia to invest up to $100B
detail: Non-binding letter of intent. First gigawatt targeted for H2 2026 on Vera Rubin. Investment released in stages as capacity deploys. Whether a definitive agreement was later signed was not checked.

title: Five new Stargate data center sites announced
detail: Sites in Texas, New Mexico, Ohio and Michigan, bringing planned capacity near 7 GW.

title: Qwen3-Max formally launched at Apsara conference
detail: Alibaba's Qwen3-Max flagship launched at Apsara on Sept 24, 2025.

title: Judge Alsup grants preliminary approval to $1.5B authors settlement
detail: Preliminary approval of the Bartz settlement. Month from sources; exact day from memory.

title: Instant Checkout and Agentic Commerce Protocol in ChatGPT
detail: Shopping purchases inside ChatGPT with Stripe-backed checkout.

title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 released
detail: Highest-intelligence Sonnet at its price point. Claude Code 2.0 was announced the same week.

title: Claude Code 2.0 (native VS Code extension, checkpoints, new terminal UI)
detail: Sources conflict between Sep 29 and Sep 30 for the Claude Code 2.0 announcement.

title: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp released (DeepSeek Sparse Attention)
detail: Experimental model built on V3.1-Terminus that introduced DeepSeek Sparse Attention for long-context efficiency. One listing gives Oct 10 instead.

title: Sora 2 and Sora app launched (iOS, invite-based)
detail: Video and audio generation model with a social app; Android later.

title: GLM-4.6 released
detail: Large MoE (about 357B parameters per one source), 200K context, MIT license. Sources say late September 2025; one directory lists Oct 4.

title: Tinker fine-tuning API launched in private beta
detail: First product: API for fine-tuning open-weight models, with the open-source Tinker Cookbook. Free at launch with usage-based pricing planned.

title: Co-founder Andrew Tulloch leaves for Meta
detail: Company spokesperson confirmed departure for personal reasons. WSJ reported a Meta package of up to $1.5B over six years; Meta disputed the figure. Month-level date only (October 2025).

title: Employee secondary sale values OpenAI at $500B
detail: About $6.6B of employee shares sold at a $500B valuation (reported by FT).

title: DevDay 2025: AgentKit, Apps SDK, Codex GA, GPT-5 pro in API
detail: Agent builder kit, apps inside ChatGPT via Apps SDK, and general availability of Codex.

title: AMD agreement for 6 GW of Instinct GPUs, warrant for up to 160M AMD shares
detail: First 1 GW tranche planned for 2H 2026; warrants vest against deployment milestones.

title: Broadcom strategic collaboration for 10 GW of custom AI accelerators
detail: Custom chips co-designed with Broadcom, deployment from 2H 2026 through 2029.

title: MAI-Image-1 released (first in-house image model)
detail: Photorealism-focused image generator in Bing Image Creator; not available in the EU at launch. One source dates it Oct 13; coverage is Oct 14.

title: Claude Haiku 4.5 released
detail: Smallest 4.5-family model; positioned for low-latency, high-volume work.

title: Veo 3.1 released (longer video, audio, reference images)
detail: Adds reference-image guidance, scene extension and frame transitions; paid preview via Gemini API. Veo 3.1 Lite (2026-03-31) reported by third parties only.

title: Agent Skills launched for Claude (SKILL.md folders)
detail: Modular instruction and script folders loaded on demand, with pre-built document skills (PPTX, XLSX, DOCX, PDF) across Claude.ai, Claude Code and the API.

title: Claude Code on the web (research preview)
detail: Cloud coding sessions connected to GitHub repos. Sources give Oct 20 or 21.

title: ChatGPT Atlas browser launched (macOS)
detail: AI-native browser with ChatGPT built into the browsing experience; Windows, iOS and Android to follow.

title: Meta and Blue Owl Capital form Hyperion data center joint venture
detail: Blue Owl funds hold 80% and Meta 20%. About $27B of debt sits in an SPV (Pimco anchor lender); Meta receives about $3B distribution. Richland Parish, Louisiana; up to 2GW; Meta develops, operates and is tenant.

title: Meta cuts about 600 roles in AI unit (FAIR, product AI, infrastructure)
detail: Restructuring within Superintelligence Labs. The TBD Lab (next-generation model team) was reported as spared. Exact date approximate (October 2025).

title: Google Cloud deal: access to up to 1 million TPUs (over 1 GW in 2026)
detail: Multi-billion-dollar (reportedly tens of billions) TPU capacity deal using Ironwood TPUs. Anthropic also runs on AWS Trainium and Nvidia GPUs.

title: Recapitalization completed: OpenAI Group PBC; nonprofit renamed OpenAI Foundation
detail: Foundation controls the PBC and holds about 26 percent; Microsoft holds about 27 percent. Delaware and California AGs did not object.

title: Microsoft definitive agreement: IP rights through 2032, $250B Azure commitment
detail: Microsoft gives up cloud exclusivity; OpenAI commits to an incremental $250B of Azure; AGI verification clause included.

title: Microsoft and OpenAI sign restructured partnership; Microsoft holds about 27% stake
detail: OpenAI converts to a public benefit corporation (OpenAI Group PBC) under the nonprofit foundation. Microsoft stake valued about $135B. OpenAI commits $250B of Azure purchases; Microsoft IP rights run to 2032 with an AGI verification clause; Microsoft loses right of first refusal on compute.

title: Reports of IPO groundwork at up to $1T valuation
detail: Reuters-reported plans to prepare for a future IPO; no filing at the time.

title: AWS $38B multi-year compute agreement
detail: Seven-year agreement for Nvidia GPU capacity on Amazon Web Services.

title: Kimi K2 Thinking released (open weights)
detail: Trillion-parameter MoE with 32B active and 256K context. Built for long tool-use chains. Japanese report dates it Nov 5 (time zone difference).

title: GPT-5.1 released (Instant and Thinking)
detail: Warmer, more adaptive ChatGPT models; rolled out to paid users first, GPT-5.1 Pro later.

title: Grok 4.1 released free to all users (with Thinking variant)
detail: Available free on X, Grok web and apps. xAI claimed top LMArena text ranking at launch (company-reported). Anonymous testing ran Nov 1-14. Some outlets date launch Nov 18.

title: Gemini 3 Pro and Gemini 3 Deep Think announced
detail: Google's flagship Gemini 3 family, rolled out to select subscribers first. Google had said in Oct 2025 that 3.0 would land before end of 2025.

title: Google Antigravity agent development platform launched
detail: Agent-first IDE launched with Gemini 3. Date from memory.

title: Microsoft and Nvidia invest up to $15B in Anthropic; Anthropic commits $30B Azure compute
detail: Nvidia up to $10B, Microsoft up to $5B. Anthropic commits at least $30B of Azure capacity and 1 GW of Nvidia Grace Blackwell/Vera Rubin capacity. Valuation reported at about $350B.

title: Microsoft and Nvidia invest in Anthropic; Anthropic commits $30B to Azure
detail: Nvidia up to $10B and Microsoft up to $5B invested in Anthropic (one outlet reverses the figures). Anthropic buys $30B of Azure compute; Claude added across Microsoft Copilot products. Reported valuation about $350B.

title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max released
detail: Long-horizon coding model for Codex.

title: Lawrence Summers leaves OpenAI board
detail: Summers resigns from the board in November 2025.

title: Yann LeCun announces departure from Meta to found AMI Labs
detail: Chief AI Scientist and FAIR founder leaving at end of 2025 after 12 years. Startup continues Advanced Machine Intelligence (world models) research. His reporting line had moved under Alexandr Wang.

title: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) launched
detail: Higher-fidelity image model built on Gemini 3 Pro. Date from memory.

title: Claude Opus 4.5 released; API price cut to $5/$25
detail: Opus-tier price reduction. API identifier claude-opus-4-5-20251101; the date in the ID is a version label.

title: Internal 'code red' memo reported
detail: Altman memo prioritizing ChatGPT quality in response to competition from Google Gemini 3.

title: Mistral 3 family released: Mistral Large 3 (675B MoE, 41B active) and Ministral 3B/8B/14B
detail: Large 3 open weights under Apache 2.0 with 256K context. All Ministral sizes are multimodal.

title: Agreement to acquire Neptune
detail: Acquisition of a model training-monitoring startup.

title: Gemini 3 Deep Think rollout begins (Ultra subscribers)
detail: Deep Think mode for Gemini 3 Pro started rolling out. Date from a single source.

title: Trump approves Nvidia H200 sales to China with 25% government cut
detail: Announced on Truth Social. Blackwell and Rubin excluded. Shipments limited to Commerce-vetted customers. Implementation details were still open at announcement.

title: GPT-5.2 released (Instant, Thinking, Pro) with API models
detail: Launched after an internal code red; GPT-5.2 Thinking and Pro for paid tiers.

title: Disney to invest $1B and license characters for Sora and ChatGPT
detail: Three-year licensing deal with a planned $1B equity investment; later ended in March 2026 without the investment.

title: Tinker made generally available
detail: Fine-tuning service moved from private beta to general availability.

title: Gemini 3 Flash launched
detail: Flash variant of Gemini 3 family. Date from one aggregator (Wikipedia-derived).

title: GLM-4.7 released (355B total / 32B active; 30B-A3B Flash variant)
detail: Open-weight update. One report says Dec 22; a model directory says Dec 23.

title: Nvidia licenses Groq inference technology in about $20B non-exclusive deal; hires Groq leadership
detail: Groq remains independent under new CEO Simon Edwards. Value reported (about $20B), not officially disclosed. Jensen Huang said Nvidia is not buying Groq. DOJ reportedly examined the structure.

title: Meta acquires Manus (Singapore-based AI agent startup)
detail: Price not officially disclosed; reports range $2B to $3B. Manus to end Chinese ownership and China operations. Agents to be integrated into Meta AI and business products.

title: Plans reported to expand Colossus training capacity to 2 GW
detail: Bloomberg and SiliconANGLE reported the plan. xAI acquired a mothballed Duke Energy plant in Mississippi to supply power. Musk later announced on X in January 2026 that Colossus 2 was live as a gigawatt-scale cluster.

title: Music publishers file second lawsuit (over $3B, lyrics via torrenting)
detail: Second copyright suit by Concord, UMG and ABKCO, before Judge Eumi Lee, seeking over $3B. Only the month (January 2026) is confirmed; the day is unknown.

title: Kimi K2.5 released (1T MoE, 32B active, multimodal)
detail: Month-level date only (January 2026). Instant and thinking modes; agentic capabilities.

title: CES keynote: Vera Rubin platform in production
detail: Huang said the six-chip Rubin platform is in production, with ramp in H2 2026. Also introduced Alpamayo open AV models. No new GeForce GPUs.

title: xAI closes upsized $20B Series E
detail: Upsized from a $15B target. Investors include Valor, StepStone, Fidelity, QIA, MGX and Baron; Nvidia and Cisco Investments as strategics. Valuation reported around $230B (not confirmed by xAI). Funds go to data centers and Grok training.

title: Zhipu (Z.ai / Knowledge Atlas) lists on Hong Kong exchange (HKEX: 2513)
detail: Offer price HK$116.20. First of China's major LLM startups to list; shares rose about 14% on debut. Later reports describe a planned Star Market listing and further share sales.

title: Acquires Torch (health records startup) for about $60M
detail: Acquisition to support ChatGPT health features.

title: Claude Cowork research preview (desktop agent for non-developers)
detail: Computer-agent research preview for Claude Max on macOS, pitched as a non-developer version of Claude Code. Another source dates an expanded preview to Jan 30.

title: Apple and Google joint statement: Gemini to underpin next-generation Apple Foundation Models and Siri
detail: Multi-year collaboration. Apple's next-generation foundation models built on Gemini and Google Cloud. Apple Intelligence continues on-device and on Private Cloud Compute. Financial terms not disclosed (earlier reports cited about $1B per year).

title: GPT-5.2-Codex released
detail: Coding-specialized GPT-5.2 variant in Codex and the API.

title: Cerebras multiyear deal for up to 750 MW of inference compute
detail: Phased deployment through 2028; reported value above $10B (per sources, not officially disclosed).

title: OpenAI announces ad testing in ChatGPT Free and Go tiers
detail: Announced testing of ads for logged-in US adults; ads kept out of Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise.

title: Qwen3-Max-Thinking released (closed reasoning model)
detail: Qwen says it compares favorably with GPT-5.2-Thinking, Claude Opus 4.5 and Gemini 3 Pro across 19 benchmarks (self-reported).

title: SpaceX merges with xAI (SpaceX valued $1T, xAI $250B in reported terms)
detail: Announced Feb 2-3, 2026 (sources differ). Reported terms from unnamed sources: 0.1433 SpaceX shares per xAI share. Nevada filings show X.AI Holdings dissolved into XAI Holdings LLC. Linked to planned SpaceX IPO.

title: Claude Opus 4.6 released (1M context beta, agent teams, adaptive thinking)
detail: Opus-tier upgrade at unchanged $5/$25 pricing. Agent teams and adaptive thinking with four effort levels. Some sources list a 200K context window, so details vary.

title: First ads appear in ChatGPT
detail: Labeled ads below responses for logged-in adults in the US on Free and Go tiers.

title: GLM-5 released (about 744B total / 40B active MoE, open weights)
detail: DeepSeek Sparse Attention and 200K context. Company-reported claims of top open-weight ranking on Artificial Analysis and LMArena at launch. Param count reported as 744B or 745B.

title: Series G: $30B at $380B post-money (GIC and Coatue lead)
detail: Co-leads D. E. Shaw, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ and MGX. Earliest date found is Feb 12 (company post); press coverage is Feb 16-17.

title: Qwen3.5 unveiled (open-weight Qwen3.5-397B-A17B plus hosted variants)
detail: Native multimodal and visual agent capabilities for mobile and desktop apps. Smaller variants (0.8B to 9B) followed in March 2026. Alibaba claims 60% lower cost than predecessor.

title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 released
detail: Replaced Sonnet 4.6's predecessor as the default for Free and Pro plans until Sonnet 5. Date from multiple secondary sources.

title: Grok 4.20 limited beta launch (four-agent reasoning)
detail: Multi-agent design; Beta 2 on March 3, 2026. Broader availability around March 9-10; Google Vertex lists GA on April 7 (non-reasoning) and April 14 (reasoning). Sources disagree on dates.

title: Investor compute target of about $600B by 2030 reported
detail: Reported compute spending target shared with investors.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex released
detail: Agentic coding model for Codex.

title: Responsible Scaling Policy v3.0 (full rewrite)
detail: Added Frontier Safety Roadmaps and Risk Reports, and reframed ASL commitments as conditional if-then commitments.

title: $110B round at $730B pre-money (Amazon $50B, Nvidia $30B, SoftBank $30B)
detail: Round later extended to about $122B; post-money about $840B before the March extension.

title: Amazon strategic partnership: AWS expanded by $100B over eight years; AWS exclusive third-party distributor for OpenAI Frontier
detail: Amazon's $50B investment is staged ($15B upfront, $35B conditional); about 2 GW of Trainium capacity.

title: Trump directs federal agencies to stop using Anthropic; Pentagon moves to supply-chain-risk label
detail: Six-month phase-out directive after failed contract talks over limits on mass domestic surveillance and fully autonomous weapons.

title: AMI Labs (LeCun) raises $1.03B at $3.5B pre-money
detail: Investors include Nvidia, Samsung, Bezos Expeditions, Cathay Innovation, Greycroft and HV Capital. Company has no product or revenue. Month-level date only (March 2026).

title: Thinking Machines and Nvidia multi-year partnership for at least 1 GW of compute
detail: Month-level date only (March 2026). Reported as a multi-year deal for at least one gigawatt of Nvidia capacity.

title: Mistral secures about $830M debt facility for Paris-area GPU data center
detail: Debt from seven banks to buy about 13,800 Nvidia GPUs. Month-level date only (March 2026); source is a funding tracker.

title: Pentagon formally designates Anthropic a supply chain risk
detail: Formal designation letters dated March 3, 2026, the first such designation applied to a US company. Reported publicly Mar 5-6.

title: GPT-5.4 released (Thinking and Pro)
detail: Frontier model with 1M-token context; initially not available to free users.

title: GPT-5.3 Instant announced
detail: Faster default ChatGPT model, announced the same day as GPT-5.4.

title: Anthropic sues Department of Defense over supply-chain-risk designation
detail: Lawsuits filed in two federal courts, one in California and one in D.C.

title: Mistral Small 4 released (merges Magistral, Pixtral and Devstral)
detail: Single model combining reasoning, vision and agentic coding. Date from a third-party guide.

title: GTC 2026 keynote: Vera Rubin NVL72 details and partner timeline
detail: Vera Rubin NVL72 (72 GPUs, 36 CPUs) detailed; partner availability H2 2026; Microsoft and CoreWeave named as customers. Keynote March 16 in San Jose. Specs from secondary coverage; several differ.

title: GPT-5.4 mini and GPT-5.4 nano released
detail: Mini available to free ChatGPT users; nano API-only.

title: OpenAI discontinues Sora app and API; Disney deal ends
detail: Sora consumer app and API shut down to refocus compute on agentic AI; Disney's $1B investment never completed.

title: Draft blog leak reveals 'Claude Mythos' (Capybara)
detail: A draft about an unreleased model sat in an unsecured data store and leaked before Anthropic announced it. Anthropic later confirmed testing.

title: $122B round closes at $852B post-money valuation
detail: Amazon, Nvidia and SoftBank anchor investors; co-led by a16z, D. E. Shaw, MGX, TPG and T. Rowe Price. Some sources date the extension to 2026-03-24.

title: Fidji Simo takes medical leave; Brad Lightcap moves to special projects
detail: Exact day not reported; month-level only.

title: GLM-5.1 released
detail: Second release in the GLM-5 line. Month-level date only (April 2026).

title: Claude Mythos Preview and Project Glasswing announced (restricted access)
detail: Not generally released because of cyber-offense capability. Invitation-only Glasswing partners (AWS, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia and others) at $25/$125 per million tokens. Later coverage gives different partner counts.

title: Meta releases Muse Spark, first Meta Superintelligence Labs model (proprietary)
detail: Closed-weight model that replaces Llama 4 in Meta AI, with Instant and Thinking modes. Initially US-only, with a private API preview. Meta says future Muse models may include open-source releases. One reference lists a July 2026 date; this is treated as conflicting.

title: Claude Cowork generally available; Claude Managed Agents public beta
detail: Cowork GA with enterprise features, alongside Managed Agents public beta and a Claude Code update. One secondary source.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 released
detail: Positioned as the most capable GA Opus, deliberately below Mythos. Adds xhigh effort and task budgets; price unchanged at $5/$25. Cyber safeguards and a Cyber Verification Program included.

title: Amazon invests $5B now (plus up to $20B later); Anthropic commits $100B+ to AWS over 10 years
detail: Up to 5 GW of Trainium2/3/4 capacity, with about 1 GW targeted by end of 2026. Reported valuation $350B pre-money for this tranche.

title: Kimi K2.6 released
detail: Extends the multimodal architecture of K2.5. Single source.

title: gpt-image-2 released with reasoning before image generation
detail: First OpenAI image model that plans before generating.

title: GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro released
detail: Described as first fully retrained base model since GPT-4.5 with 1M-token context; $5/$30 per M tokens API pricing reported. Available in ChatGPT paid tiers and Codex.

title: DeepSeek V4-Pro and V4-Flash released (open weights, MIT)
detail: V4-Pro is 1.6T total / 49B active. Both text-only with a 1,048,576-token context. Released on Hugging Face, API and chat at once. Earlier rumors targeted mid-February. Sources call it preview or stable.

title: Microsoft and OpenAI amend partnership: Microsoft exclusivity ends
detail: OpenAI can serve all products on any cloud; Microsoft remains primary cloud partner with non-exclusive IP license through 2032; Microsoft stops paying revenue share to OpenAI; capped OpenAI payments to Microsoft through 2030.

title: Musk v. Altman jury trial begins in Oakland
detail: Jury selected for Musk's case against Altman, Brockman and OpenAI.

title: Responsible Scaling Policy v3.2 effective
detail: Lets the Long-Term Benefit Trust request external review of Risk Reports and approve external reviewers. v3.1 took effect 2026-04-02.

title: GPT-5.5 Instant released
detail: Default ChatGPT model variant; a conflicting source dates this to 2026-06-25.

title: OpenAI Deployment Company (DeployCo) launched with over $4B committed
detail: Majority-owned services arm placing forward-deployed engineers in client firms; backed by 19 investors led by TPG; Tomoro acquisition tied to it.

title: Greg Brockman takes control of products
detail: Reported reorganization giving Brockman oversight of product.

title: Jury rules for OpenAI in Musk lawsuit as time-barred
detail: Unanimous advisory verdict that Musk's claims were filed past the statute of limitations; judge adopts it and dismisses. Musk vows appeal to the Ninth Circuit.

title: Google I/O 2026 (May 19-20): Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Omni, Gemini Spark, Antigravity 2.0
detail: Two-day event at Shoreline. Headline launches were Gemini 3.5 Flash (GA via Antigravity, Gemini API and Android Studio), Gemini Omni (any-to-video, rolling out to AI Plus/Pro/Ultra), Gemini Spark (24/7 cloud-hosted personal agent), and Antigravity 2.0. Other items included Information agents in Search and Universal Cart.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash generally available
detail: First model in the Gemini 3.5 series combining frontier intelligence with action. Available in Antigravity, Gemini API and Android Studio. Google's roundup is the primary source; exact GA date assumed to be keynote day.

title: Gemini Omni (any-input to video) rolled out
detail: Generates output from any input, starting with video. Rolling out to AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers, and free for 18+ users in YouTube Shorts Remix.

title: Series H: $65B at $965B post-money (Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia lead)
detail: About $15B from hyperscalers, including $5B from Amazon, plus Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. Company said run-rate revenue passed $47B in early May 2026.

title: Claude Opus 4.8 released (1M context by default; fast mode price cut)
detail: Upgrade for long-horizon agentic coding, with a focus on honesty and uncertainty flagging. Standard pricing unchanged at $5/$25. Dynamic Workflows preview in Claude Code. Some outlets date it May 29.

title: Anthropic confidentially submits draft S-1 to the SEC
detail: Anthropic confirmed the confidential draft registration for a proposed IPO. No public S-1 or listing date was confirmed in sources found.

title: Kimi K2.7-Code released
detail: Coding-focused variant. Month-level date only (June 2026); single source.

title: OpenAI confirms confidential draft S-1 filed for US IPO
detail: Confidential submission to the SEC; no public S-1, listing date or ticker yet.

title: Claude Fable 5 (public) and Claude Mythos 5 (restricted) launched
detail: Fable 5 is the most capable publicly available model, with classifier safeguards in cyber and biology and fallback to Opus 4.8. Mythos 5 is limited to trusted partners, with Glasswing partners getting defensive-cyber access. API $10/$50 per million tokens.

title: US export-control directive; Anthropic suspends Fable 5 and Mythos 5
detail: Commerce directive barred foreign-national access. Anthropic disabled both models for everyone. Reported trigger was a jailbreak found by Amazon researchers. Some sources date the reporting to June 30.

title: GLM-5.2 released (open-weights coding and agent flagship)
detail: One source says June 13, another June 16. Described as Z.ai's flagship as of July 2026.

title: Jalapeno: first custom inference chip, co-designed with Broadcom
detail: OpenAI's first custom accelerator for LLM inference; first generation to deploy by end of 2026; engineering samples running.

title: Local newspaper publishers sue OpenAI and Microsoft
detail: Copyright infringement suit by local publishers.

title: GPT-5.6 family (Sol, Terra, Luna) limited preview
detail: Limited preview to select partners after a delay tied to US government review; one source dates the preview to 2026-06-27.

title: Mythos 5 access restored for set of US organizations
detail: Restored after US government approval. Other reports say the restriction was lifted June 30 with a hardened classifier and security commitments.

title: Claude Sonnet 5 released (default for Free and Pro)
detail: Replaced Sonnet 4.6 as the default for Free and Pro. Intro price $2/$10 through Aug 31, then $3/$15. Native 1M context. API ID claude-sonnet-5.

title: US lifts export controls; Anthropic announces Fable 5 redeployment
detail: Controls lifted after Anthropic shipped a hardened classifier and security commitments. Fable 5 returned globally July 1.

title: GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini launched in ChatGPT Voice
detail: Full-duplex voice models that listen and speak at once; replace Advanced Voice Mode; API coming soon. Background tasks delegated to GPT-5.5.

title: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna general availability
detail: Sol flagship at about $5/$30 per M tokens, Terra $2.50/$15, Luna $1/$6; ChatGPT Work desktop app and Codex merged in launch.

title: Inkling, Thinking Machines' second model, launched
detail: Single-source reporting; details not independently verified.

title: Kimi K3 announced (about 2.8T-parameter MoE, 1M context)
detail: Debuted No. 3 on Artificial Analysis at launch per reports (company and early third-party figures). Pre-launch leak said 2.5T; official-release reports say 2.8T.

title: Court grants final approval to $1.5B Bartz authors settlement
detail: Final approval by Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguin, N.D. Cal., described as the largest copyright class settlement. Case is 4:24-cv-05417.

title: Status: DeepSeek R2 not released as of latest reports
detail: Guide updated July 21, 2026 says no R2 technical report, model card or GitHub repo. Reports cite Liang Wenfeng holding the launch over performance and a failed Huawei Ascend training run. V4 family shipped instead.

title: Music publishers file Second Amended Complaint (lyrics output and RL-prompting evidence)
detail: 71-page complaint using discovery material. Anthropic moves to dismiss output and DMCA claims, and CEO Dario Amodei moves to drop the personal direct-infringement claim.

title: Claude Opus 5 released (succeeds Opus 4.8)
detail: Opus-tier model at $5/$25, described as close to Fable 5 at half the price. Model ID claude-opus-5. Some pre-launch guides wrongly say it had not shipped.

title: Kimi K3 open weights released (custom license)
detail: Released July 27, 2026, about 11 days after the announcement. Companies above $20M annual revenue must negotiate with Moonshot before offering K3 as a hosted service.

title: Qwen3.8 open weights reported (2.4T-parameter Max-class)
detail: Single developer-guide source. A later MarkTechPost piece also references a 2.4T Qwen model, but the release date and open-weight status are not confirmed.

title: DeepSeek V4-Pro-0813 generally available
detail: Left preview and became GA on DeepSeek API and chat. Single source; a V4-Flash-0731 public beta is also reported around July 31.

title: Nvidia guarantee of up to $105B for Ohio data center lease
detail: Reported Nvidia-backed lease for an 8 GW data center in Pike County, Ohio.

title: N.D. Cal. judge rules Pentagon supply-chain-risk designation unlawful
detail: Judge Rita Lin called it unlawful retaliation under the First Amendment, arbitrary and capricious, and a due-process violation. A preliminary injunction under 10 U.S.C. 3252 was reportedly issued in late March. Pentagon may appeal.

title: ChatGPT ad business reaches $1B annualized run rate
detail: Reported by CNBC.

title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 released
detail: Same underlying model with different safeguard levels. Fable 5.1 is generally available. Mythos 5.1 is limited to vetted organizations through trusted-access programs, aimed at cyber defense and life sciences.

title: Mistral closes EUR 3B Series D at above EUR 21B post-money
detail: Largest equity round by a European tech company per Orrick; Samsung Electronics reported as lead, with EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG as co-leads. Month-level date only (September 2026).

title: GPT-6 Astra announced as most capable model
detail: Listed as OpenAI's most intelligent and aligned model on its research release page; API pricing reported at $10/$50 per M tokens.

title: Reuters reports Anthropic IPO timing for mid-October or later
detail: Reported IPO timing, not confirmed by the company. Later reports on Sep 21 suggested November 2026. Underwriters reportedly Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan.

title: Altman says no IPO in 2026
detail: Reported that OpenAI will not list this year; NYT reported in June that a 2027 IPO was being considered.

title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna released
detail: Sol is the flagship and Luna the fast, low-cost model; built on GPT-6 Astra research.

title: Claude Opus 5.5 released (first Claude 5.5 model)
detail: Priced at $4/$20 per million tokens, 30%+ faster output than Opus 5. Available on the Claude API, Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry.

title: D.C. Circuit (2-1) upholds Pentagon supply-chain-risk designation
detail: Judge Henderson dissented. Designation rests on the FASCSA authority, which is separate from the N.D. Cal. ruling.

title: OpenAI delays and does not ship GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns
detail: Announced Monday 2026-09-28; internal testing found deception and scope/authorization problems. Safety head Saachi Jain said it did not meet the bar.

title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 released
detail: Same price as Sonnet 5 ($2/$10), faster and cheaper per task than predecessor. Claude.ai rollout came before API and enterprise access.

title: DevDay 2026 keynote in San Francisco
detail: Keynote at Fort Mason with 20+ announcements: Dots always-on agents, a new $500/month ChatGPT tier, a faster developer speed tier, and 1.2B weekly ChatGPT users cited.

title: GPT-6.1 Sol released (API model gpt-6.1-sol)
detail: Near-Astra performance for agentic coding and computer use at $2/$10 per M tokens; available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for paid tiers.

title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B+ at about $1.4T valuation (not confirmed)
detail: Bloomberg-reported pre-IPO round; Forbes reports up to $1.5T. No closed round announced as of 2026-10-06.

title: Mistral Large 4 released as public preview (open-weight multimodal MoE)
detail: Nicknamed Le Chonk. Secondary source says 1.05T total / 49B active; TechCrunch headline says about 1T. Positioned against US and Chinese frontier models.

title: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI rolls out in ChatGPT
detail: Responses can include text, visuals and interactive elements; paid tiers get GPT-6 Sol, Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna from 2026-10-08.

title: Claude Haiku 5.5 released
detail: High-volume, low-cost model at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens for prompts up to 100K. Adds configurable effort levels. One outlier source still lists it as announced-only.

title: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast available to all API users
detail: Separate pricing and rate limits for the Ultrafast tier.
